story_fr: O'Reilly Automotive enregistre une hausse de 9,0 % des ventes comparables au deuxième trimestre 2023, surpassant les attentes du secteur.
story_en: O'Reilly Automotive posts a 9.0% comparable store sales increase in Q2 2023, outperforming sector expectations.
quote: comparable store sales increased 9.0% for the second quarter of 2023

story_fr: O'Reilly réalise en 2021 une 29e année consécutive de croissance des ventes comparables, un record rare dans la distribution automobile.
story_en: O'Reilly achieves its 29th consecutive year of comparable store sales growth in 2021, a rare record in auto parts retail.
quote: 29th consecutive year of comparable store sales growth

story_fr: O'Reilly ouvre en juillet 2023 son premier centre de distribution au Mexique, une surface de 370 000 pieds carrés qui marque l'entrée officielle sur ce marché.
story_en: O'Reilly opens its first distribution center in Mexico in July 2023, a 370,000 sq ft facility marking its official market entry.
quote: opened our first distribution center in Mexico...approximately 370,000 square feet

story_fr: O'Reilly lance au premier trimestre 2022 une initiative de tarification professionnelle visant à accélérer la conquête du marché professionnel de pièces automobiles.
story_en: O'Reilly launches a professional pricing initiative in Q1 2022 aimed at accelerating market share gains in the professional auto parts segment.
quote: professional pricing initiative...launched during Q1 2022 to accelerate our market share gains

story_fr: Depuis 2011, O'Reilly a racheté pour 17,63 milliards de dollars de ses propres actions, soit 86,9 millions d'actions, témoignant d'une politique de retour au capital très agressive.
story_en: Since 2011, O'Reilly has repurchased $17.63 billion worth of its own shares, totaling 86.9 million shares, reflecting an aggressive capital return policy.
quote: repurchased $17.63 billion...86.9 million shares since January 2011 inception

story_fr: Greg Johnson annonce sa retraite au 31 janvier 2024 ; Brad Beckham, co-président opérationnel depuis 2023, lui succède à la tête d'O'Reilly Automotive.
story_en: Greg Johnson announces his retirement effective January 31, 2024; Brad Beckham, co-president since 2023, succeeds him as CEO of O'Reilly Automotive.
signal: Succession CEO : Beckham prend les rênes
quote: Greg Johnson...will retire...Brad Beckham...will succeed Mr. Johnson as Chief Executive Officer
